gltf_coordinate_system.authoring: Blender Z-up, front -Y; exporter converts to glTF Y-up

art_direction: Detailed original parametric stylized athletes. Sculpted cross-section meshes; engineered equipment; no body primitive placeholders. Not scans or hand-sculpted photoreal assets.

Muscularity.meaning: Pectoral, deltoid, bicep, forearm and leg contour expansion

ShoulderWidth.meaning: Shoulders and arm origins shift laterally by up to 0.03 m per side

ChestSize.meaning: Pectoral and back depth and chest width

Wingspan.meaning: Arm endpoint shift 0.045 m laterally and 0.02475 m downward per side

HandSize.meaning: Palm and five fingers scale 1.0–1.2 about wrist

Reach.meaning: Arm endpoint shift 0.025 m laterally and 0.01375 m downward per side

physique_runtime.height: uniform scale at model/armature parent = requested_height_m / archetype.measurements.height_m; scales visible meshes, bone translations, IK targets, bounds and gameplay contacts together. Adult height fixed unless optional arcade progression.
physique_runtime.strength: map strength rating to Muscularity, ShoulderWidth, ChestSize, ArmThickness and LegPower. Each baseline already includes an archetype-specific athletic build; additive morphs are deltas.
physique_runtime.weight: BodyWeight is visual volume; mass in kg remains an explicit gameplay value. Do not infer mass from mesh volume.
physique_runtime.skeleton_adjustment: For ShoulderWidth, Wingspan and Reach: apply the same analytic morph displacement to all relevant arm/hand bone rest head/tail locations, then update inverse bind matrices before playing clips. For HandSize, scale hand/finger rest lengths about wrist. Source morph function is authoritative. Recompute IK, glove contact samples and physical bounds from current skinned mesh/bones.
physique_runtime.contact_contract: Use final glove/finger bone transforms and mesh surfaces for catch reach; no invisible catch radius. Capsule collision can approximate body volume but cannot decide ball contacts.
physique_runtime.combinations: Morph targets are additive; clamp weights to [0,1]. Validate extreme combinations in engine, including animation posing, before production release.

rig.hand_ik: No runtime IK solver is embedded in glTF. Hand/forearm chains and finger rotations are authored; engine must apply two-bone arm IK and finger grip solving to track a live ball.
rig.retargeting: All archetypes share bone names and topology; rest proportions differ. Preserve scale and rebuild contact bounds when retargeting.

lod.LOD0: Full surface meshes, animated skin and nine physique targets.
lod.LOD1: Lower radial surface resolution with same rig, materials, morph names and animation library.
lod.performance: Actual device frame-rate benchmarking is deferred to game integration; no 60 FPS guarantee.

known_limits: Animations are original authored keyframe clips, not motion capture.
Clips require engine blending, grounding and ball-aware IK; standalone clips do not determine catch success.
LOD meshes include individual fingers, accessories and complete animation data; mobile performance must be measured.
Skeletal proportions for extreme combined physique settings require runtime rest-pose adaptation as described above.

height_customization.realistic_training: Improve jumping, technique and reach mechanics without changing adult height.

strength_preview_mapping.meaning: Supplied helper visible progression from 60 to 95 strength, with independent physique sliders applied separately. Runtime must recompute body bounds, reach samples, mass/contact balance and skeleton rest proportions from the final displayed athlete.
